# Which screens to photograph, and in which appearance.
#
# Edit this file and commit — the Preview screens workflow runs on the change and
# posts the shots into its job log (and as artifacts). GitHub's web editor works
# fine from a phone.
#
# screens:    studio, home, archive, course, summit, yearbook, prints, wall-art,
#             map-studio, gallery-studio, detail, components
#             wall-art accepts a style: wall-art:grid, wall-art:ridgeline, wall-art:rings,
#             wall-art:thread, wall-art:strata
#             timeline accepts a scope: timeline:years, timeline:months, timeline:all,
#             timeline:gallery
#             print-engine runs the print writer's self-check and reports pass/fail
# appearance: light, dark, or both
#
# Requested for b509: the glyph set was confirmed good at native resolution in b508 — five
# outlines on one grid, tinting for selection in both appearances — so this is about the
# gallery alone.
#
#   timeline:gallery — it should now open at the FOOT, on the newest month, which is the whole
#   point of the Timeline's arrangement. Two passes have opened at the top instead. The waiting
#   diagnosis was wrong: the landing fires with data in hand, and the target was simply
#   unreachable — a LazyVGrid nested inside a LazyVStack, so `scrollTo` could not resolve a
#   position four hundred tiles down that the outer container had not built the inner one for.
#   It is one sectioned grid now, the same shape as the All scope that lands correctly.
#
#   Also check the month headers have room: the grid's row spacing is 2pt, so the 22pt gap the
#   stack used to give between months had to be rebuilt as padding above each header.
#
# screens: a product tile can be named directly, e.g. studio@lithograph

screens=timeline:gallery
appearance=both
